penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: A Salesforce metadata diff/validation tool requires integrating with Salesforce orgs and Copado APIs via OAuth, which involves per-customer credential setup, environment configuration, and likely manual troubleshooting for each new customer's org structure — not automatable end-to-end by Claude alone.

penalties_applied.name: high_touch_support
penalties_applied.reason: Enterprise Salesforce/Copado customers will have bespoke org configurations, requiring ongoing human-judgement support to diagnose edge cases in metadata sync behavior.

rationale: The pain is genuinely high-severity — silent deployment failures in a production Salesforce CI/CD pipeline represent real production-incident risk, and the buyer (a Salesforce DevOps engineer at a Copado-paying enterprise) absolutely has budget and a reason to care. However, building a meaningful metadata diff and validation layer on top of Copado's proprietary DevOps model requires deep Salesforce API integration (Metadata API, SOAP/REST, OAuth per org), significant custom tooling, and per-customer configuration that cannot be automated by Claude + a simple page in a week. The operational autonomy score is too low: every new enterprise customer needs hands-on setup, and support for Salesforce org edge cases requires domain expertise that cannot be delegated to Claude reliably.
solution_plan: The micro-service would be a Salesforce metadata drift detector — a tool that compares what's in a Copado User Story commit against what actually changed in the org's Setup UI, flagging items like permission set changes that Copado silently missed. Building this is not feasible for a non-technical solo operator: it requires authenticating to multiple Salesforce orgs, calling the Metadata API, diffing XML metadata, and maintaining a sync state — none of which Claude + a simple form + Stripe can accomplish without substantial custom engineering. A non-technical operator could not build, sell, or maintain this without hiring a Salesforce developer. The honest recommendation is to pass on this unless the operator has a technical co-founder with Salesforce API experience.
notes: Total falls to 3.6 after penalties, well below validate threshold. Additionally fails buildability_with_ai gate (5 < 6 floor) and operational_autonomy gate (5 < 7 floor). This is a genuine enterprise pain problem but not buildable within the factory's constraints.
